ticks.note: A delayed transition without a trigger means "one tick later, always". Tick 1 only enters A. KIELER warns that A's second transition is not reachable: the first one, having no trigger, always wins.
A's untriggered transition fires (x = 1, state B); the second one never gets a chance although I is true.
B's untriggered delayed transition fires one tick after B was entered: x = 2, state C.
C has no transitions; x stays 2. A's second transition (taken index 1) never fired.
